comment: If you want an A, don't take her. She's sweet and is very knowledgeable, but her feedback does not help. Me and my team made massive improvements on our project and did great for our final presentation and got a sub par grade. She's so stingy, and make sure to raise your hand often and participate.

By far the worst teacher i had at the university of richmond, made me completely regret majoring in entrepreneurship. You are graded on two projects but even if you do well on them she will kill you in participation. Quite literally grades you based on how many times you raise your hand. Plays clear favorites as well.
Don't take this Professor. Grading is unfair, not willing to help and the class requires most of your time as a student and you won't be rewarded for it.
Tests are not gone over during lectures properly. She lectures and expects you to participate at the same time, and participation is a huge grade that she does not grade fairly.

I had Professor Aronson for MGMT 347, but I liked her MGMT 351 class more. I think the flow of the class is better. Mainly discussion around case studies and a group project. I learned way more in this class than 347. I enjoyed her passion and enthusiasm towards innovation. Most of the semester revolves around quizzes and a big group project!

She's new to teaching and it shows. The majority of my class thought her tests were stupid and unfair. Reads off of powerpoint slides &tests you on the book. No energy or enthusiasm. Participation is a huge part of your grade, yet there are very few opportunities to say anything because she's rushing through material. Harsh grader on final project

Prof Aronson is new at UR and it shows. Never really seemed to get her feet under her this semester. Nice person, wants students to do well, but gives extremely unclear guidelines with numerous syllabus changes. Pop quizzes were all over the place, but I expect those to be more reasonable based on feedback. Group project was good if your team was.
